description:
Reusable worker configuration.

All fields are flat (no nesting).  Optional fields (``timeout_seconds``,
``max_turns``, etc.) default to ``None``, meaning the value is inherited
from the spawning session at spawn time.

name.description: Unique name for this worker definition.
name.title: Name

description.description: Human-readable description of what this worker does.
description.title: Description

system_prompt.description: System prompt used to initialise the worker agent.
system_prompt.title: System Prompt

tools.description: List of tool names this worker is allowed to call.
tools.title: Tools

worker_permissions.description: Permission categories required by this worker, e.g. ``{"filesystem": "read"}``.
worker_permissions.title: Worker Permissions

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum wall-clock time for a single worker turn.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

max_turns.description: Maximum number of turns before the worker stops.
max_turns.title: Max Turns

temperature.description: LLM temperature override for this worker.
temperature.title: Temperature

critical_threshold_tokens.description: Token count threshold for critical warning. Used as ``token_monitor_critical_threshold`` in this worker's AgentConfig. Defaults to 80000.
critical_threshold_tokens.title: Critical Threshold Tokens

title: WorkerDefinition
